# Sree Hari Saradha Vidhyalaya Matriculation School (S.H.S.V.M School)

> Sree Hari Saradha Vidhyalaya Matriculation School is a co-educational Tamil Nadu State Board Matriculation school in Pakkam, Thiruvallur District, Tamil Nadu, established in 1999.

## Key Facts
- **Official Name**: Sree Hari Saradha Vidhyalaya Matriculation School (S.H.S.V.M School)
- **Alternate Names**: Sree Hari Saradha Vidyalaya, Shree Hari Saradha Vidhayalaiya, SHSVM School, SHSVM
- **Established**: 1999
- **Motto**: Smile • Study • Serve
- **Affiliation**: Tamil Nadu State Board (Matriculation)
- **School Type**: Co-educational
- **Levels Offered**: Primary, Upper Primary, Secondary
- **Campus Address**: Pakkam, Thiruvallur District, Tamil Nadu 602024 (Korattur Thinnanur Periyapalayam Road, SH-50A, near Avadi)
- **Geographic Coordinates**: 13.1536061, 80.0378861
- **Operating Hours**: Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 5:30 PM (Sunday closed)
- **Helpline Phone**: +91 89394 21231
- **WhatsApp**: 918939421231
- **On-Campus Facilities**: Academic Book Bank, Recreation Playground, Medical Support
